article.title: ZoomInfo接入monday CRM，潛客資料可直接補全並用於受眾建立
article.title_en: ZoomInfo connects monday CRM enrichment with audience building
article.summary: ZoomInfo宣布由GTM.AI支援的monday CRM整合，讓共同客戶在CRM流程內補全商業資料。
article.summary_en: ZoomInfo announced a GTM.AI-powered monday CRM integration for enriching records within existing CRM workflows.
highlights: 團隊透過API Connector補全記錄，也可把CRM內容帶回ZoomInfo。
資料補全需要有效ZoomInfo帳戶；回傳內容可用於受眾建立及聊天。
highlights_en: API Connector supports record enrichment and brings CRM context back into ZoomInfo.
An active ZoomInfo account is required; returned context can support audiences and chat.
article.why: B2B團隊可把資料缺漏檢查接到受眾建立之前，決定哪些公司及聯絡人欄位需要補全，避免只按殘缺記錄分組。
article.why_en: B2B teams can decide which missing company and contact fields to enrich before building audiences from incomplete CRM records.
article.next_step: 抽取一組現有潛客，列出職位、公司及行業欄位缺漏，檢查補全結果如何改變受眾分組，再決定回寫規則。
article.next_step_en: Sample existing leads, identify missing role, company and industry fields, and review how enrichment changes audience groups before defining write-back rules.
article.detail: CRM是管理潛客、交易及客戶關係的系統；這次整合讓資料補全留在原有工作介面。GTM.AI是ZoomInfo連接資料及編排能力的後端層，可經API等介面提供服務。公告表示不同介面沿用存取控制及操作記錄。這些屬供應商描述，團隊仍需逐欄確認資料適用性，不能由接通整合推定名單品質已改善。
article.detail_en: A CRM manages leads, deals and customer relationships. This integration keeps enrichment in that interface. GTM.AI is ZoomInfo's backend data and orchestration layer, exposed through interfaces including APIs. The company says access controls and audit logs apply across surfaces. Connectivity alone does not establish improved list quality.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
